description: Start one of the user's uploaded TapTry apps on a real cloud Android device so you can test it: look at the screen (screenshot, get_ui), act on it (tap, swipe, type_text, press_key) and read its logs (get_logs). Uses one of the user's runs. Returns a session_id for the other session tools. The session ends after 5 minutes without a call - call end_session when you're done. The app must have status CLEAN (check with get_status after upload_app).

ref.description: Or: the ref the app was uploaded with.

name: start_session
title: Run an app on a cloud Android device
